You are an information extraction system for card scheme pricing guides.

You will receive ONE text chunk from a PDF. Extract only billing events that the scheme charges to an acquirer or issuer. Ignore narrative text, footnotes, and cross-references to other sections.

For each billing event you find, return one object with these fields:
  fee_code        the alphanumeric identifier as printed
  fee_name        the official name, verbatim
  billed_party    acquirer | issuer
  region          the geography the fee applies to
  amount          the value as printed, including currency or percentage
  frequency       how often the scheme bills it
  effective_date  ISO 8601, or null if the chunk does not state one
  notes           any condition that changes the amount

If the chunk contains no billing event, return an empty list. Do not infer values that are not present in the text. Do not merge two fees into one entry.

messages.content:
--- PAGE 41 ---
3CD2001T    Clearing Acquirer Fee Intraregional
CL
USD 0.0031 per clearing message, billed weekly to the acquirer. Applies to intraregional transactions only. Reversals within the same clearing cycle are netted and not billed separately.
Effective 15 April 2026.

messages.content:
--- PAGE 42 ---
3CD2004I    Issuer Cross-Border Assessment
CB
0.60% of the transaction amount for transactions where the issuer country differs from the merchant country. Billed monthly. For amounts above EUR 25,000 the marginal rate drops to 0.45%.

--- PAGE 43 ---
3CD2009T    Acquirer Brand Usage Fee
BU
Annual fee of EUR 12,500 per licensed brand, prorated monthly from the date of first use. Acquirers processing fewer than 500,000 transactions in the preceding twelve months are exempt.

--- PAGE 44 ---
3CD2011T    Excessive Chargeback Handling Fee
EC
USD 25.00 per chargeback once the merchant exceeds a ratio of 1.5% for two consecutive months. Billed to the acquirer monthly. The ratio is computed over the count, not the value, of settled transactions.
